roles.Op.lean: The op: its body, its fact, their codecs, the relations its fact is filed in, scope and claimed time.
roles.Validate.lean: The validator: what the op requires, and the fact it produces from them.
roles.View.lean: The component for this op's fact. It reads only its own fact.
roles.Tests.lean: Tests of the ops in this folder.
roles.Family.lean: The registry: this folder's op, then each child folder's registry, as plain functions.

nodes.summary: The app: the node's hooks and live data, the app shell, and laws over the node and the whole app.
Where this window is: the page and the way back. Ephemeral.
This device's preferences, each a local op.
System, light or dark: the newest wins.
A community, founded by its root. The root's fact is the founder's admission.
This device's own keys. Local, never sent.
A signing key pair, from a 32-byte seed.
The node's X25519 key, one per node.
The community's name, set by an admin. Counted, so the newest wins.
A member's name: a register, newest by time.
Custom emoji, listed with the built-in catalogue.
This node's copy of a content key. Local.
A content key sealed to one node's X25519 key.
Who is in: invitations, requests, approvals, admissions, admins and removals.
An invitation, with how many approvals a request needs.
A device redeems an invitation. It admits nobody.
A member's signed yes to a request.
A tally of exactly enough approvals, by distinct users. Unsigned.
An admin grants admin. Never revoked.
A removal, by an admin or of oneself. It never invalidates an op.
This device's own record of joining. Local.
A join in progress: the invite, the request and the name chosen.
Stop waiting on a join.
This device is in a community.
A channel. Today every community has one, unnamed, and this folder holds its messages.
A post. Its header is clear and its body sealed. It claims a counter and a time.
An emoji on a message, by an admitted device.
A file on a message: its Merkle root and length in clear, the rest sealed.
One 64 KiB slice of a file's ciphertext, with its Merkle path.
This device's receipt of a saturated post, which orders it. Local.
Unsent text for one conversation. Today the composer.
The Noise handshake and sessions, made of ops.
One ephemeral X25519 secret for one handshake. Local.
Noise message 1, on the bare wire to one peer.
The responder's record of a request it read. Local.
Noise message 2, on the bare wire.
This side's session keys. Local.
A courier: the one way out for handshake bytes. Local.
When and how an op arrived. Local.
A removal notice given on a connection. Local.
What holds for every op type. It names no kind.

Range-based set reconciliation for every op type: three wire messages that are never stored. rbsr (240) carries one room's claims for one round, or with no room the hello; have (241) lists ids the sender holds, and is also the live stream; want (242) asks for ids, answered with their bytes.
The shells, and the headless twin the tests drive.
